string.name: LauncherAbility_desc
string.value: Sample for subscribing to and publishing common events

string.name: sample_desc
string.value: This sample demonstrates how to subscribe to and publish common events. Because the app publishes sticky events, which is a system capability, the sample is released as a system app; third-party apps cannot use this capability.

string.name: once_tips
string.value: The following events take effect only in this run:

string.name: screen_on_tips
string.value: Do not use the phone, screen-on detected

string.name: screen_off_tips
string.value: Do not use the phone, screen-off detected

string.name: wifi_tips
string.value: Do not use the phone, Wi-Fi connected or disconnected

string.name: screen_lock_tips
string.value: Do not use the phone, screen locked

string.name: screen_unlock_tips
string.value: Do not use the phone, screen unlocked
